name: Auto-approve Copilot PRs
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Auto-approve Copilot PR
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
        with:
          github-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"

yaml:
name: Auto-approve Copilot PRs
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Auto-approve Copilot PR
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
